candidates.name: Halfaya-Kahla Gas Pipeline
aka: Halfaya GPP-Amara/Maysan power plants gas supply line
candidates.to: Al-Kahla power station (with onward dry-gas supply to Amara Government and Maysan Investment power stations)

evidence.note: 24-inch, ~21 km pipeline from Halfaya field to a gas collection unit near the Al-Kahla power station; pilot deliveries of 40 MMcf/d to the 180 MW Al-Kahla plant — first operational associated-gas project of Iraq's second bid round.
300 MMscf/d Halfaya associated-gas processing facility opened; dry gas delivered to the Amara and Maysan power plants, feeding >1,200 MW of generation in Maysan governorate.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row covers gas leaving Halfaya: P6832 (Bazargan-Halfaya) is the INBOUND Buzurgan->Halfaya 18-in/70km sour-gas leg, and P4058 (Eastern Iraq Gas Pipeline, 48-in) does not match the 24-in/21-km spec. The Halfaya->Kahla dry-gas outlet has operated since 2013 and now carries Halfaya GPP output to the Amara/Maysan power stations, yet appears nowhere in the roster by name, aka, or endpoints. Borderline only against P4058 if GEM intended that row to represent the Maysan power-supply corridor; consolidator should check P4058's route.
